CREATE TABLE "public"."t" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "count" int4 DEFAULT 100000 NOT NULL,
  "docs" jsonb[] DEFAULT ARRAY['{}', '[]']::jsonb[] NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "meta" jsonb DEFAULT '{"plan":"free","seats":1}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT 'anonymous' NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '1.50'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "ratio" float8 DEFAULT 1.5 NOT NULL,
  "scores" int4[] DEFAULT ARRAY[1, 2]::int4[] NOT NULL,
  "small" int2 DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "t_docs_elem_not_null_3ecbeb56" CHECK (array_position("docs", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "t_scores_elem_not_null_0d0de0bd" CHECK (array_position("scores", NULL) IS NULL)
)
